source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("public space" OR "public spaces") AND (urban OR city OR cities OR street OR streets)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("public space" OR "public spaces") AND (urban OR city OR cities OR street OR streets),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("public space" OR "public spaces") AND ("cities" OR "city" OR "street" OR "streets" OR "urban"))
